description: This file defines the ServiceDiscoveryClient class for AWS Route 53 Auto Naming service in PHP, including method annotations for various asynchronous and synchronous service operations.

classes.name: ServiceDiscoveryClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon Route 53 Auto Naming service, extending AwsClient with specific methods for service operations.

methods.name: createHttpNamespace
methods.description: Creates an HTTP namespace in Route 53 Auto Naming.

methods.name: createPrivateDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a private DNS namespace.

methods.name: createPublicDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a public DNS namespace.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a new service in the namespace.

methods.name: deregisterInstance
methods.description: Deregisters an instance from a service.

methods.name: discoverInstances
methods.description: Discovers instances associated with a service.

methods.name: discoverInstancesRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the latest revision of instances for a service.

methods.name: discoverInstancesRevisionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves latest revision of instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific instance.

methods.name: getInstancesHealthStatus
methods.description: Gets the health status of instances.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Gets details about a specific operation.

methods.name: listInstances
methods.description: Lists instances associated with a service.

methods.name: updateInstanceCustomHealthStatus
methods.description: Updates an instance’s custom health status.

methods.name: updatePrivateDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a private DNS namespace.

methods.name: updatePublicDnsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a public DNS namespace.
